home: A clear record of focused time
Studydown turns time with your iPhone face down into a private Activity ledger for work, learning and everyday life. Choose an Activity, start, then place the screen down.
facts: Studydown records time while the iPhone lies face down. Pick it up to pause, then continue according to your timer settings.

Keep up to 3 Activities and 300 seconds (5 minutes) of total recorded time, with Today and This Week summaries and a basic CSV file. This is not a daily allowance. Lifetime Pro removes both limits; a face-down session already underway is saved without trimming.

One lifetime purchase unlocks unlimited Activities, monthly, yearly and custom analysis, weekly goals, Deadlines, Apple Watch, Widgets, advanced hero styles, and complete JSON backup and restore. There is no subscription.
No account, developer server, advertising, analytics or tracking is involved. Your app records remain on your device.
support: Practical help with face-down timing, access levels, restoring a purchase and looking after your files.
faqs: Choose or create an Activity, start the timer, then place the iPhone flat and still with the screen facing down. Recording begins once Studydown detects that position.
Check that the iPhone is close to flat, is not moving and Studydown is active. A steep angle or continued movement can stop face-down detection.
How do I restore Lifetime Pro?
Open the Lifetime Pro screen and select Restore Purchases while using the Apple Account that made the purchase. Apple confirms your access.
What is the difference between CSV and JSON?
A basic CSV file is included free for spreadsheet-style records. Lifetime Pro adds complete JSON backup and restore. Files are made only when you ask and saved wherever you choose.
privacy: The Studydown app does not collect personal data. Your focus records are handled and stored on your device.
support_details: How can I check a short session?

In Settings, set Shortest session to keep to 3 seconds. Choose an Activity, tap Start timing, and keep the iPhone still and face down for at least 10 seconds after detection. Keep Studydown active and the phone unlocked. Lift it and end the session or let the grace period expire. Sessions shorter than your chosen minimum are discarded.

In Settings, turn reminders on or off and choose a daily time or an interval of 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 or 12 hours. Notifications need permission, but declining them does not prevent timing. Locking the phone or leaving the app stops active time accumulation; iOS can still deliver scheduled reminders.
privacy_details: Reminder settings and notification text stay on the device. iOS schedules local notifications; Studydown does not use a remote push server or upload a device token. Notification permission is requested when you enable reminders or use the permission control, not on first launch.

StoreKit may contact Apple to load products and localised prices and to verify, buy or restore Lifetime Pro. The app reads verified transaction and entitlement information, not payment details, and sends no focus records for purchases. Apple's services follow Apple's terms. CoreMotion processes orientation and movement locally, not camera images; motion tracking stops when the app becomes inactive.

Widgets use local App Group storage. Live Activities have no server push. Apple Watch uses WatchConnectivity to exchange Activity names and identifiers, session times, summaries, preferences and entitlement state with the paired iPhone, not a developer server. Saved records remain until erased or replaced. Settings → Your data → Erase all data deletes local records after confirmation. Exported files, Watch copies and any Apple-managed device backups are separate; erasing app data does not guarantee erasing those copies. Device backups depend on your system settings.
privacy_sections: Activity names, focus sessions, summaries, weekly goals, Deadlines and settings remain in local app storage. Studydown has no account or developer server.
Studydown reads orientation and movement only when needed to recognise that the iPhone is face down. Raw sensor readings are not retained, sent or linked to you.
Buying or restoring Lifetime Pro makes StoreKit communicate with Apple. Apple handles the transaction, and Studydown never receives your payment details.
CSV and JSON files are created only at your request. You decide where to save or share them; the chosen destination then applies its own privacy terms.
If you email us, we receive the address and message you choose to provide. They are used only to respond and are not sold or used for advertising.

This static site uses no cookies and loads no analytics, ads, trackers or third-party scripts. GitHub Pages hosts the files and may process ordinary connection information under its own privacy terms.
